I don't have a policy excerpt covering account deletion, so I can't advise on that directly.

However, I can confirm: **you can keep your Plant Club active independently.** Plant Club is managed separately under "Account" > "Subscriptions"—cancelling your account wouldn't automatically cancel it, but I'd recommend confirming the exact process with our Support Lead to make sure your account closure doesn't affect the subscription.

Let me escalate this to ensure you get the right steps for both. A Support Lead will contact you at rvshankar45@gmail.com.
